When I select "Add Note" from the Action menu for an opportunity
And I enter valid note "Note Sample" and save the note
Then the note should be saved successfully
And the note should be associated with the selected opportunity
And the opportunity "Last Updated" timestamp should be updated accordingly
And I deleted that opportunity note
